verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say it captures the receipt as soon as the card is swiped and fills in memos and categories, so no expense report is filed. Its own features also send reminders for missing items, and the CLI exposes transactions missing, flag-missing and explain-missing alongside receipt upload and attach. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that e-receipts are pulled from third-party integrations (e.g. email or merchant apps), documentation that nudges fire only when a receipt is genuinely missing rather than as blanket reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
